exercises.title: Two in a Row
exercises.instruction: Capture both white pieces in one turn.

feedback.initial: Sometimes one capture leads directly to another.
feedback.selected: Make the first jump. If another capture is available, your turn is not over.
feedback.success: Exactly. After your first capture, you had another available jump, so you had to keep going.
feedback.invalidPiece: Choose the black checker that can capture.
feedback.invalidDestination: After a capture, you must continue jumping whenever another capture is available.

exercises.title: Three Jumps
exercises.instruction: Follow the capture sequence all the way to the end.

feedback.initial: A multiple jump can continue more than once.
feedback.success: Good. A capture sequence continues until that piece has no further capture available.
feedback.invalidDestination: Keep following the capture sequence. You cannot stop while another jump is available.

exercises.title: Around the Corner
exercises.instruction: Complete the capture sequence, even when it changes direction.

feedback.initial: Multiple jumps do not have to continue in the same direction.
feedback.selected: Take the first piece, then look again from your new square.
feedback.success: Right. Each landing creates a new position. If another capture is available from there, you continue.
feedback.invalidDestination: Look for the next capture from the square where your king just landed.

feedback.initial: Sometimes more than one complete capture sequence is available.
feedback.selected: You may choose the route, but once you begin, you must complete its available jumps.
feedback.success: Correct. When several captures are available, you may choose among them. You are not required to choose the route that captures the most pieces.
feedback.invalidDestination: Choose one of the available capture routes and continue it until no further jump is available.

exercises.title: Keep Jumping
exercises.instruction: Find and complete the legal turn.

feedback.initial: Put everything together: captures are compulsory, and so are their continuations.
feedback.success: Excellent. A multiple jump is one turn, and every available continuation must be completed.
feedback.invalidPiece: Find the piece with the compulsory capture.
feedback.invalidDestination: Complete every jump in the capture sequence.
